CIPOpen.descrizione: The CIPOpen instruction opens a CIP class 3 connection (Large_Forward_Open) with the specified remote node. The data length is set to 1,994 bytes.
CIPOpen.funzione: The CIPOpen instruction opens a CIP class 3 connection (Large_Forward_Open) with a remote node on a CIP network. The remote node is specified with route path RoutePath . The data length is set to 1,994 bytes. Handle is output when the connection is open. TimeOut specifies the connection timeout time. If a response does not return from the remote node within the connection timeout time after the CIPSend, CIPWrite, or CIPRead instruction is executed, it is assumed that communications failed. The connection timeout time is reset when the CIPRead, CIPWrite, or CIPSend instruction is executed and the remote node returns a response. The data type of Handle is structure _sCIP_HANDLE. The specifications are as follows: Name Meaning Description Data type Valid range Unit Default Handle Handle Handle _sCIP_HANDLE --- ---

CIPRead.descrizione: The CIPRead instruction uses a class 3 explicit message to read the value of a variable in another Controller on a CIP network.
CIPRead.funzione: The CIPRead instruction reads the value of the network variable specified with source variable name SrcDat from another Controller on a CIP network. The other Controller is specified with Handle . The read data value is stored in DstDat . Size specifies the number of elements to read. If SrcDat is an array, specify the number of elements to read. If SrcDat is not an array, always specify 1 . If the value of Size is 0 , nothing is read regardless of whether SrcDat is an array or not. When the read operation is completed, the number of bytes of the data that was read is assigned to read data size
CIPRead.st: CIPRead_instance(Execute, Handle, SrcDat, Size, DstDat, Done, Busy, Error, ErrorID, ErrorIDEx, RcvSize);

CIPSend.descrizione: The CIPSend instruction sends a class 3 CIP message to a specified device on a CIP network.
CIPSend.funzione: The CIPSend instruction sends service data ServiceDat for the service specified with service code ServiceCode as a class 3 explicit message. The destination is specified with handle Handle . RqPath specifies the request path. Size specifies the number of elements to send. If ServiceDat is an array, specify the number of elements to send. If ServiceDat is not an array, always specify 1 . If no service data is required, set Size to 0 .
CIPSend.st: CIPSend_instance(Execute, Handle, ServiceCode, RqPath, ServiceDat, Size, RespServiceDat, Done, Busy, Error, ErrorID, ErrorIDEx, RespSize);

CIPUCMMRead.descrizione: The CIPUCMMRead instruction uses a UCMM explicit message to read the value of a variable in another Controller on the specified CIP network.
CIPUCMMRead.funzione: The CIPUCMMRead instruction reads the value of the network variable specified with source variable name SrcDat from another Controller on a CIP network. The other Controller is specified with route path RoutePath . The read data value is stored in DstDat . Size specifies the number of elements to read. If SrcDat is an array, specify the number of elements to read. If SrcDat is not an array, always specify 1 . If the value of Size is 0 , nothing is read regardless of whether SrcDat is an array or not.

CIPUCMMSend.descrizione: The CIPUCMMSend instruction sends a UCMM CIP message to a specified device on a CIP network.
CIPUCMMSend.funzione: The CIPUCMMSend instruction sends service data ServiceDat for the service specified with service code ServiceCode as a UCMM explicit message. The destination is specified with route path RoutePath . RqPath specifies the request path. Size specifies the number of elements to send. If ServiceDat is an array, specify the number of elements to send. If ServiceDat is not an array, always specify 1 . If no service data is required, set Size to 0 .

CIPUCMMWrite.descrizione: The CIPUCMMWrite instruction uses a UCMM explicit message to write the value of a variable in another Controller on a CIP network.
CIPUCMMWrite.funzione: The CIPUCMMWrite instruction writes the value of the network variable specified with destination variable name DstDat at another Controller on a CIP network. The other Controller is specified with route path RoutePath . The content of source data SrcDat is written. Size specifies the number of elements to write. If DstDat is an array, specify the number of elements to write. If DstDat is not an array, always specify 1 . If the value of Size is 0 , nothing is written regardless of whether DstDat is an array or not.

CIPWrite.descrizione: The CIPWrite instruction uses a class 3 explicit message to write the value of a variable in another Controller on a CIP network.
CIPWrite.funzione: The CIPWrite instruction writes the value of the network variable specified with destination variable name DstDat at another Controller on a CIP network. The other Controller is specified with Handle . The content of source data SrcDat is written. Size specifies the number of elements to write. If DstDat is an array, specify the number of elements to write. If DstDat is not an array, always specify 1 . CNC_CoordHalt.descrizione: The CNC_CoordHalt instruction stops the currently running CNC motor assigned to the positioning axis in the specified CNC coordinate system.

CNC_CoordImmediateStop.descrizione: The CNC_CoordImmediateStop instruction immediately stops all the currently running CNC motors in the specified CNC coordinate system.

CNC_CoordReset.descrizione: The CNC_CoordReset instruction clears the error in the specified CNC coordinate system.

CNC_CoordResetMCode.descrizione: The CNC_CoordResetMCode instruction resets the M code output from the NC program.

CNC_CoordStop.descrizione: The CNC_CoordStop instruction performs an immediate stop for all the currently running CNC motors in the specified CNC coordinate system.

CNC_GantrySkewControl.descrizione: The CNC_GantrySkewControl instruction controls the skew of the gantry axes.

CNC_Home.descrizione: The CNC_Home instruction operates the Servomotor to determine home using the limit signals, home proximity signal, and home signal.

CNC_HomeWithParameter.descrizione: The CNC_HomeWithParameter instruction sets the homing parameter and operates the Servomotor to determine home using the limit signals, home proximity signal, and home signal.

CNC_LoadProgramFile.descrizione: The CNC_LoadProgramFile instruction loads an NC program from an external non-volatile memory into the main memory.

CNC_Move.descrizione: The CNC_Move instruction performs absolute positioning or relative positioning.

CNC_MoveJog.descrizione: The CNC_MoveJog instruction jogs a CNC coordinate system according to the specified target velocity.

CNC_Power.descrizione: The CNC_Power instruction makes a Servo Drive ready to operate.

CNC_Read.descrizione: The CNC_Read instruction reads CNC parameters.

CNC_SpindleGo.descrizione: The CNC_SpindleGo instruction controls the normal rotation, reverse rotation, and stop for the CNC motor assigned to the spindle axis.

ChangeFTPAccount.descrizione: The ChangeFTPAccount instruction changes the FTP login name and password of the built-in EtherNet/IP port on a CPU Unit or those of an EtherNet/IP Unit.
ChangeFTPAccount.funzione: The ChangeFTPAccount instruction changes the FTP login name and password of the built-in EtherNet/IP port or EtherNet/IP Unit that is specified with UnitNo (Unit number), to the values specified with FTP login name NewUserName and password NewPassword . When Execute changes from FALSE to TRUE, the values of NewUserName and NewPassword are written as the FTP login name and password of the built-in EtherNet/IP port. The settings are not applied yet when Done changes to TRUE. If you specify an EtherNet/IP Unit with UnitNo , the EtherNet/IP Unit is restarted when execution of the instruction ends. FileGets.funzione: The FileGets instruction reads a text string of one line from the position of the file position indicator in the file specified by file ID FileID in the SD Memory Card. The text string that is read is written to read text string Out . The following three line feeds are automatically detected: CR, LF, and CR+LF. RecSearch.descrizione: The RecSearch instruction searches an array of structures for elements that match the search key with the specified method.
RecSearch.funzione: The RecSearch instruction searches Size elements in the array of structures In[], i.e., from In[0] to In[ Size -1], for Member (member to search) that matches the search key Key . The member to search of an element in In[] is passed to Member as an argument. If any matching element is found, the value of search result Out changes to TRUE. The element number of the matching element is assigned to InOutPos[0] and the number of matching elements is assigned to Num . If there is more than one matching element, the element number of the lowest matching element in In[] is assigned to InOutPos[0]. If there are no matching elements, the value of Out will be FALSE, and InOutPos[0] and Num will be 0. Always attach the element number to input parameter that is passed to In[], e.g., array[3]. The data type of search method Mode
RecSearch.st: Out:=RecSearch(In, Size, Member, Key, Mode, InOutPos, Num);

Always attach the element number to the in-out parameter that is passed to InOut[], e.g., array[3]. The data type of Order (sort order) is enumerated type _eSORT_ORDER. SubOU.descrizione: The SubOU (-OU) instruction subtracts integers or real numbers. It also performs an overflow check for the integer subtraction result.

In the combination of the different data types, however, one of the data types should be able to accommodate values held by the other data type. Calculations are performed based on the data type that accommodates every possible value held by the other existing data type.
